'''Feruun Lern''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] during the time of the [[Mandalorian Wars]].

==Biography==
During the Mandalorian Wars, Lern became a dominant figure at the outpost [[Unity (outpost)|Unity]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Caillte]], in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. Lern invited people to come to the base, so that they could rediscover the warriors within themselves and established themselves as new Neo-Crusader soldiers.

Lern and many of his followers left Unity at the end of the Mandalorian Wars, to participate in the [[Battle of Malachor V]]. The Neo-Crusaders were defeated in the battle and Lern returned to Unity. He and his followers abandoned the base during the [[Jedi Civil War]], to join forces with the Mandalorian [[Canderous Ordo]]. Lern and Ordo sought glory by fighting against the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] during the [[Dark Wars]] and Lern was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the conflict.

==Personality and traits==
Feruun Lern was highly regarded by his fellow Mandalorians and by the time of the Jedi Civil War, was viewed by them as a traditionalist.
